payload.reason: The evidence describes how the paper integrates a language model with cross-lingual word embedding to enhance context-aware search in translation tasks.

claims.text: The paper integrates context information into word-by-word translation by combining a language model with cross-lingual word embedding.
The proposed methods improve word-by-word translation of cross-lingual embeddings by using a language model for context-aware search.
The system surpasses state-of-the-art unsupervised neural translation systems by integrating a language model without costly iterative training.
